idea.title: John Pork Is Calling
idea.hook: Your phone won't stop ringing. John Pork, Grandma and Diquavios want to talk - but so do scam bots and telemarketers. Read the caller in a heartbeat: ANSWER your people, DECLINE the spam. Miss a call or pick up a scammer and you lose a heart. Decline John Pork and he calls back FURIOUS.
idea.prototype: Reaction/decision arcade (vanilla JS canvas + WebAudio) styled as a smartphone in portrait. A full-screen incoming-call card shows a caller portrait, name and a shrinking timer ring; two big thumb buttons DECLINE (red, left) / ANSWER (green, right). Each caller is either a FRIEND (answer = score x combo) or SPAM (decline = score). Wrong choice or letting the ring expire costs one of 3 hearts and resets the combo; 0 hearts = GAME OVER. Combo multiplier climbs with consecutive correct reads; call windows shrink and arrive faster as the score grows. Signature characters carry their own rules: John Pork is the star (always answer) and DECLINING/IGNORING him triggers a red ANGRY-PORK rage screen + heart loss; Grandma can heal a heart ('made you cookies!'); Diquavios pays DOUBLE and sparks a brief chaos flash. Spam cast = Scam Likely / Unknown / Telemarketer / Brainrot Bot, drawn as caller-ID style icons. All character art is procedural canvas (reliable, on-meme) with optional AI hero portraits layered via GF.drawSprite. Procedural pitched SFX per caller + GF.bgMusic ringtone bed. Persistent best score + interactive teach-by-doing first two calls (scripted John Pork then a scammer).
idea.mutation_of: Reigns-style binary swipe/decision game crossed with a reaction time-pressure arcade and a face-reading 'sort the cast' loop (Papers-Please-lite), wrapped in the viral 'John Pork is calling' phone-call meme
idea.why_novel: Tim's explicit brief: 'create john pork calling game add diquavios and other stuff and grandma'. No portfolio game has a binary ANSWER/DECLINE decision core or a phone-UI framing; closest cousins are reflex-tap games (bug_beat, bubble_barrage) which are spatial tap-to-destroy, not a read-the-character judgement loop. The distinctive hook is character literacy under time pressure + the John Pork rage gimmick that punishes declining the meme's title character.
idea.non_timer_pressure: lives (3 hearts) - the LOSE condition is hearts<=0 from wrong reads (answering spam / declining friends / ignoring a call), never a global clock; the per-call ring is a per-decision urgency cue, not a countdown to game over
idea.lose_condition: gs='GAMEOVER' when hearts <= 0 (reachable in ~30-60s from a few wrong calls)

sources.snippet: No mechanic-class match: existing reflex games are spatial tap-to-destroy. John Pork Is Calling is the portfolio's first binary decision (answer/decline) + character-reading loop and first phone-UI framed game.

synthesizer_brief: Direct Tim prompt build (2026-06-20, interactive). Built VANILLA: the entire game is a phone UI + character portraits + per-caller WebAudio SFX/ringtones on gf-lib's shared audio context (hard rule #8), which the meme framing and procedural portrait art fit naturally. v0.1 ships the addictive 10-minute core loop (read caller -> answer/decline -> combo + speed ramp + 3 hearts, with John Pork rage / Grandma heal / Diquavios double as signature rules). Persistent reason-to-return (daily/idle/quests/unlockable cast) deferred to the iteration ladder.
